this is an asci rendition of bad apple, org animation story border "Μμ" at https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm4693242 and built upon by "あにら" to the version we all know today at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i41KoE0iMYU (although it was previously realsed on niconico douga but wont be able to find that). full backstory (havent checked but assume so) can be found here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6QY4ekac1_Q . the raw text frames were made by me using a bash script and images of each frame from the well known video, my git repo where the asci files are available in diffrent resolutions can be found here https://github.com/doinguss/textfiles . have fun ^^ !!1! remember to include "-animation-" in the tile of any text file u want to animate followed with a two char int ex "05" or "15", the lines/frame for the files on my git is indicated by the number inside the parenthesis.
